intervals.label: collaboration: approval
intervals.locator: Greybook record for NA38 (JSON, experiment details)
intervals.note: Approval date as recorded in Greybook; Specht (2014 slides) lists NA38 as approved 09/1985. The interval ends when NA38 first took data (autumn 1986).

intervals.label: collaboration: data taking (proton, oxygen and sulphur beams)
intervals.note: The start is stated (data taken from the fall of 1986: first 200 GeV protons on uranium, then oxygen ions; the 1988 NA38 paper). The end year is inferred: the last NA38 heavy-ion sample named in the fetched sources is the large S+U sample of 1992 (Table 7.2 of arXiv:hep-ph/0412158: '1992 200 20.5% S+U 8 × 107 113'); the years of NA38's 450 GeV proton-nucleus runs are not given.
intervals.quote: It had started its data taking with oxygen beams in 1986

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.note: Terminal event inferred from the last documented NA38 data set (S+U, 1992); no fetched source states the NA38 end date. NA50 followed with Pb beams (first documented Pb-Pb sample 1995).
intervals.quote: NA38 then collected a significantly larger sample of S+U events (see Table 7.2)

website.quote: Study of vector meson and dimuon production in p, O, and S-induced collisions at the CERN SPS

summary.plain: The mainly French-Portuguese collaboration that ran the NA38 dimuon experiment at the CERN SPS before NA50 extended it with Italian groups.
summary.technical: NA38 Collaboration (spokesperson Louis Kluberg, contact person Peter Sonderegger); the historical mainly French-Portuguese collaboration later enlarged into NA50 (arXiv:2603.10835); formation date and membership not recorded.
